in_hebrew.name: Fuchs

in_greek.name: Fuchs
in_greek.long_meaning: Fuchs είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the German word for fox. In heraldry, a fox represents cunning and resourcefulness.

in_latin.name: Fuchs
in_latin.long_meaning: Fuchs est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the German word for fox. In heraldry, a fox represents cunning and resourcefulness.
